content.text: Check covers 2025-* so it validated the new file.

I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `331924d 2025-12: add rows`, following the project's commit-message rule.

Before committing I ran `scripts/check.sh` and it printed OK. It checks every `data/2025-*.csv` file (the year comes from `scripts/check.conf`), so the new file was included.

The original is still in `inbox/` because I copied it rather than moving it. Say if you want it removed.
